Resolves #20875

The board family joins the engine as `Neo.board`: one `data.Store` of cards projected into columns and swimlanes, where a move is one `record.set({status, order})` and every other view of the store follows. It ships with its unit specs, the two neo themes, and `examples/board/basic`, which puts the board beside a table bound to the same store instance. The leaf is mine by the steward's transfer on the ticket; the sibling moves #20885, #20888 and #20898 set the shape.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chrome on the example in all four environments with real pointer drags, plus frames) → L3 required (AC-3 runs the example in four environments; AC-5 reads frames). No residuals.

## Deltas from ticket

- The example's second view is a table (`Neo.grid.Container`) on the same store instance, which the view root's state provider holds. The table takes the board's palette.
- Column reordering ships. The live slot motion of a dragged column and #20871 stay out, per the transfer comment.
- From the design read: the card in flight lifts, the landing slot shows as a dashed accent block (`neo-board-card-slot`, set by `SortZone` for the length of the gesture), and an over-limit column marks only its header's edge and badge.
- Structural pre-flight (fast path): `src/board/*.mjs` follows the flat layout of `src/gantt/` and `src/scheduler/`. Map maintenance: the Structural Inventory gains one row for the four planning families, which had none.
- From the code review: `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone` reads its owner switch through `isResortable()` (the owner's `dragResortable`), so `ColumnSortZone` drags columns on `columnsResortable` alone. The board owns only the stores it creates, as the scheduler does.

      **Commit:** `2d1c2ed736`
      **Details:** `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone` now reads its owner switch through `isResortable()` (by default the owner's `dragResortable`) at drag start and at drop. `ColumnSortZone` overrides it with `columnsResortable`, and its own five reads of that switch go through the override. `ColumnSortZone.spec.mjs` "columnsResortable alone admits a column drag…" starts and drops a drag with cards off, across a locked column, then cancels one, and checks that cards on with columns off admits nothing. The base spec's stand-in zone gained the hook it now calls.

- [x] **`[ADDRESSED]`** **RA-3 — Reconcile every lane when both derived axes expand.** At [Container:1192](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d1693fae3d745b70abb148ba24aa66fa439e64d9/src/board/Container.mjs#L1192), a new lane receives the new global columns but existing lanes do not. With `columns:null`, changing A once to `{status:'doing', lane:'two'}` leaves lane one with only Todo and lane two with Doing+Todo. Moving B into Doing/one returns null; a full project repairs it. Add the simultaneous-new-status/new-lane case and preserve one batched Record change.
      **Commit:** `2d1c2ed736`
      **Details:** When a change brings a status that no column holds, every lane takes the derived column set, a new lane included. With explicit `columns`, only the new lane is projected. `LaneRow.spec.mjs` "one set that brings a new status and a new lane…" asserts one `recordChange`, `['doing', 'todo']` in both lanes, and the `moveCard` into Doing/one.

- [x] **`[ADDRESSED]`** **RA-4 — Resolve stale editor identity at Save.** [CardEditor:673](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d1693fae3d745b70abb148ba24aa66fa439e64d9/src/board/CardEditor.mjs#L673) writes its captured Record. Store replacement/reload does not reconcile or close that edit. A title-only Save against the retired Record writes it, hides and reports success while the current same-key Record remains unchanged. Refuse or explicitly reconcile stale edits at the canonical boundary; cover replacement/reload and the normal single-write control.
      **Commit:** `2d1c2ed736`
      **Details:** Refuse. `save()` resolves the Record by key through `board.getSourceRecord()`. When that is not the bound Record, nothing is written and `save()` returns null. The editor then rebinds to the current Record of the same key and stays open with its values, or hides when the key is gone, and the board announces either outcome. I chose refusal over reconciling, because a replacement store can reuse a key for another record. `CardEditor.spec.mjs` "Save against a Record a reload or a Store replacement retired…" covers the reload, the single-write control, and a replacement store without the key.

Both are valid distinct Store Records, but both Cards receive the same ID; the second fails manager identity resolution. Keep their UI identities distinct without rewriting caller keys. Add this case, `Neo.get(card.id) === card` assertions and the existing string-escape controls.
      **Commit:** `2d1c2ed736`
      **Details:** `Board.slug()` keeps types apart. Numbers and ordinary strings keep their text, so `__card__1` and the escape controls are unchanged. A string that reads as a number, and any other type, leads with `_<type>_`, which no escape can produce. Caller keys are untouched. `Container.spec.mjs` "a number key and a string key that read the same…" asserts distinct ids, `Neo.getComponent(card.id) === card` for both cards, and seven distinct slugs for `1, '1', NaN, 'NaN', true, 'true', 1n`. The escape test stays as it was.

- [x] **`[ADDRESSED]`** **RA-6 — Retire Stores the Board instantiates.** [beforeSetStore:424](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d1693fae3d745b70abb148ba24aa66fa439e64d9/src/board/Container.mjs#L424) creates Stores, while replacement/destruction only detach listeners. The default config-created Store remains live and registered after replacement, as does its successor after Board destruction; the borrowed control correctly survives. Track creator ownership and retire those instances after rebinding/teardown, preserving borrowed Stores; cover both controls.
      **Commit:** `2d1c2ed736`
      **Details:** `beforeSetStore()` records the stores it creates in `#ownedStores`, the scheduler's pattern. A replacement retires the previous owned store after its successor is bound, and `destroy()` retires the owned store after the container. A borrowed store is never destroyed. `BoardRetirement.spec.mjs` "a Store the board creates retires…" covers both controls through `Neo.get()`.

Wording: `slug()`'s JSDoc now states the type rule, and the store hooks' JSDoc states the ownership rule.
